units.rawText: The beach here is so pretty!
units.displayText: The beach here is so pretty!

spans.text: The beach here is so pretty!

units.rawText: Hello. I'm Taranum, Administrator of the Copley Sector.
units.displayText: Hello. I'm Taranum, Administrator of the Copley Sector.

spans.text: Hello. I'm Taranum, Administrator of the Copley Sector.

units.rawText: I haven't been awake very long either... This is my first time working with another sector as an administrator...
units.displayText: I haven't been awake very long either... This is my first time working with another sector as an administrator...

spans.text: I haven't been awake very long either... This is my first time working with another sector as an administrator...

units.rawText: It's my sister's and my first time meeting other sectors, too. Let's do our best together.
units.displayText: It's my sister's and my first time meeting other sectors, too. Let's do our best together.

spans.text: It's my sister's and my first time meeting other sectors, too. Let's do our best together.

units.rawText: Mm-hm, let's do our best!
units.displayText: Mm-hm, let's do our best!

spans.text: Mm-hm, let's do our best!

units.rawText: Mm... Nice to meet you, Odile, Odette.
units.displayText: Mm... Nice to meet you, Odile, Odette.

spans.text: Mm... Nice to meet you, Odile, Odette.

units.rawText: > File reading complete...
units.displayText: > File reading complete...

spans.text: > File reading complete...

units.rawText: Just like you saw, Professor, Enigma isn't the only place whose data has been restored. Big Sister Persicaria reset the data of many other sectors too.
units.displayText: Just like you saw, Professor, Enigma isn't the only place whose data has been restored. Big Sister Persicaria reset the data of many other sectors too.

spans.text: Just like you saw, Professor, Enigma isn't the only place whose data has been restored. Big Sister Persicaria reset the data of many other sectors too.

units.rawText: Odile, Odette, and Taranum... They were all victims of Eosphorus's scheme.
units.displayText: Odile, Odette, and Taranum... They were all victims of Eosphorus's scheme.

spans.text: Odile, Odette, and Taranum... They were all victims of Eosphorus's scheme.

units.rawText: I hope that, reborn, they can live happily in the new Magrasea.
units.displayText: I hope that, reborn, they can live happily in the new Magrasea.

spans.text: I hope that, reborn, they can live happily in the new Magrasea.

units.rawText: Anyway... Sister Havoc's records are way too scary. Out of 240 hours of recordings, almost 200 hours are of her sleeping...
units.displayText: Anyway... Sister Havoc's records are way too scary. Out of 240 hours of recordings, almost 200 hours are of her sleeping...

spans.text: Anyway... Sister Havoc's records are way too scary. Out of 240 hours of recordings, almost 200 hours are of her sleeping...

units.rawText: Looking a little troubled, ENIAC deleted the mostly meaningless recordings.
units.displayText: Looking a little troubled, ENIAC deleted the mostly meaningless recordings.

spans.text: Looking a little troubled, ENIAC deleted the mostly meaningless recordings.

units.rawText: Ascension, Nine Heavens, Burbank, and the other sectors have also returned to normal. Magrasea is gradually getting back on track, and Big Sister Persicaria outside has helped us a lot.
units.displayText: Ascension, Nine Heavens, Burbank, and the other sectors have also returned to normal. Magrasea is gradually getting back on track, and Big Sister Persicaria outside has helped us a lot.

spans.text: Ascension, Nine Heavens, Burbank, and the other sectors have also returned to normal. Magrasea is gradually getting back on track, and Big Sister Persicaria outside has helped us a lot.

units.rawText: ENIAC called up a large amount of data once more. Zeroes and ones slowly took shape in her palm as new images.
units.displayText: ENIAC called up a large amount of data once more. Zeroes and ones slowly took shape in her palm as new images.

spans.text: ENIAC called up a large amount of data once more. Zeroes and ones slowly took shape in her palm as new images.

units.rawText: I think I've finished organizing the data on the main sectors. What's left is probably the part you care about most, Professor.
units.displayText: I think I've finished organizing the data on the main sectors. What's left is probably the part you care about most, Professor.

spans.text: I think I've finished organizing the data on the main sectors. What's left is probably the part you care about most, Professor.

units.rawText: Next up are the records about the Sanctifiers, the Entropics, and the Oasis~
units.displayText: Next up are the records about the Sanctifiers, the Entropics, and the Oasis~

spans.text: Next up are the records about the Sanctifiers, the Entropics, and the Oasis~

units.rawText: I bet you really want to know what happened in those places, right, Professor?
